sentences.text: % 15.04.2024 Petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ('Cr.P.C.') has been preferred on behalf of the petitioners for quashing of FIR No. 237/2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S.: Civil Lines and proceedings emanating therefrom.
Learned APP for the State/respondent no. 1 appears on advance notice and accepts notice.

Respondent No. 2 be served by all permissible modes on necessary steps being taken by the petitioners including through IO/SHO P.S. concerned, returnable on 30.04.2024.
List on 30.04.2024.
This is a digitally signed order.
